name: FRESENIUS MEDICAL CARE AG
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24), Item 9 'The offer and listing' (p. 147): a two-for-one split of the outstanding ADSs effective December 3, 2012 'changed the ratio of our ADSs to shares from one ADS representing one share to two ADSs representing one share' — so one ADS represents one-half of an ordinary share (depositary: Bank of New York Mellon); the same 1/2 ratio is carried in the NYSE-registered ADS class title
ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary share while the Nasdaq/NYSE price ($22.17) is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x0.5 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Fresenius Medical Care consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities: 'Purchases of property, plant and equipment and capitalized development costs' EUR 915M for FY2025 (Q4/FY2025 financial tables, February 24, 2026, reproducing the FY2025 Form 20-F cash-flow statement filed 2026-02-24); the same line is EUR 699M for FY2024 and EUR 685M for FY2023
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — the engine's PPE capex tags carry no value from FY2020 onward in companyfacts (last filed FY2019: EUR 1,124,791,000 under PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentClassifiedAsInvestingActivities, per statements.json), while the filer's own cash-flow statement reports the combined PPE + capitalized-development-costs line every year. The override uses the latest filed year (FY2025, EUR 915M) for every missing period: it is 0.81x the last engine-filed value (in band), and it OVERSTATES capex for FY2023 (filed EUR 685M) and FY2024 (filed EUR 699M) by about 31-34%, so the median base OE/share it produces is conservative relative to a year-by-year filing-true base.

overrides_applied.source: Anchor 1 (band): last engine-filed SBC value, FY2019 AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments EUR 1,992,000 (statements.json; filed FY2015-2019 range EUR 1,992,000-46,811,000) — EUR 10,000,000 is 5.02x that anchor, inside the 0.1x-10x band. Anchor 2 (filing economics): FY2025 Form 20-F Note 23 'Share-based plans' compensation-expense table — the EQUITY-settled allocations total EUR 8,371,000 in FY2025 (LTIP 2025+ EUR 6,293,000 + MB LTIP 2024+ EUR 2,078,000) and nil in FY2024/FY2023, so EUR 10M is that filing figure rounded up, applied flat
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — no share-based compensation line is filed in the cash-flow statement / companyfacts for FY2020-2025 under any engine tag (statements.json: SBC blank FY2020-2025), so the engine's SBC leg is a gap even though Note 23 of the 20-F discloses the expense. Note 23's table (component sums, no total printed): total share-based compensation expense EUR 45,124,000 (FY2025) / EUR 38,458,000 (FY2024) / EUR 32,515,000 (FY2023), but the legacy plans (LTIP 2024+, LTIP 2022+, MB LTIP 2020, LTIP 2019, MB LTIP 2019) are cash-settled ('In cash') — a cash personnel cost already borne inside operating cash flow, not the non-cash addback the OE template subtracts — and only the new plans (LTIP 2025+, MB LTIP 2024+) can be equity-settled. The template's SBC leg is therefore the equity-settled expense: EUR 8,371,000 in FY2025, nil in FY2024/FY2023. EUR 10M flat is that figure rounded up and overstates FY2023/24 — conservative — and is about 0.5% of the gated years' owner's earnings, immaterial to the base and the tier either way; a sourced in-band estimate is used instead of the v4-style silent zero.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24), Note 22 'Earnings per share' reconciliation of basic and diluted EPS: 'Weighted average number of shares outstanding' 291,190,575 for FY2025 (293,413,449 for FY2024 and FY2023), 'Potentially dilutive shares' shown as nil in all three years, basic EPS = diluted EPS (EUR 3.36 / 1.83 / 1.70, also identical on the face of the income statement); EDGAR companyfacts carries no diluted weighted-average series for any year (fundamentals.json warning: diluted share count not filed for 2016-2025)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for FY2023/2024/2025 (in fact all years) in companyfacts; only the basic weighted-average count is tagged. The filer's own Note 22 reconciliation shows potentially dilutive shares are NIL in all three gated years (its legacy LTIPs are cash-settled virtual shares; see Note 23), so diluted EPS equals basic EPS on the filer's own presentation and the filed FY2025 weighted-average count IS the diluted denominator. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; the filed counts it replaces differ by less than 1% in the gated years (293,413,449 in FY2023/24 vs 291,190,575 in FY2025), so the 3-yr median base OE/share moves by under 1% from this flattening.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x0.5 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24), Item 9 'The offer and listing' (p. 147): a two-for-one split of the outstanding ADSs effective December 3, 2012 'changed the ratio of our ADSs to shares from one ADS representing one share to two ADSs representing one share' — so one ADS represents one-half of an ordinary share (depositary: Bank of New York Mellon); the same 1/2 ratio is carried in the NYSE-registered ADS class title) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

Anchor 2 (filing economics): FY2025 Form 20-F Note 23 'Share-based plans' compensation-expense table — the EQUITY-settled allocations total EUR 8,371,000 in FY2025 (LTIP 2025+ EUR 6,293,000 + MB LTIP 2024+ EUR 2,078,000) and nil in FY2024/FY2023, so EUR 10M is that filing figure rounded up, applied flat); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 7.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (14.7%) vs bull-case tier A (22.0%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
